# Meta Marketing API (Graph API) read-side research, 2026-10-17

Sources are developers.facebook.com unless marked. "Unconfirmed" = not found on an official page during this pass.

## 1. Version and base URL

- Base URL: `https://graph.facebook.com/v{N}/{path}`. Always send the version; unversioned calls use the app dashboard's default. https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/guides/versioning/
- Newest Graph API version: **v26.0** (introduced July 29, 2026). Table: v25.0 Feb 18 2026 -> Jul 29 2028; v24.0 Oct 8 2025 -> Feb 18 2028; v23.0 May 29 2025 -> Oct 8 2027; v22.0 -> May 20 2027; v21.0 -> Jan 21 2027; v20.0 -> Sep 24 2026. Each Graph version lives at least 2 years. https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog/
- Marketing API has its own, shorter schedule: v24.0 available until **Oct 6, 2026**, v23.0 ended Jun 9 2026, v25.0/v26.0 TBD. Changelog also says "Marketing API version auto-upgrade will be released on July 29, 2026." Recommendation: pin **v26.0** (or v25.0) and treat the version as config. https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/marketing-api-changelog
- Expired versions are routed to the next oldest usable version (Graph API rule).

## 2. Permissions, access tiers, tokens

Permission descriptions (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/permissions/):
- `ads_read`: read Ads Insights for ad accounts you own / are granted. Enough for insights + campaign/adset/ad reads.
- `ads_management`: read and manage ad accounts. Needed only for writes, but Lead Ads docs list it among lead-retrieval prerequisites.
- `leads_retrieval`: "retrieve and read all information captured by a lead ads form". Required to read leads.
- `pages_show_list`: list Pages a person manages (needed to find Pages and get Page tokens).
- `pages_read_engagement`: read Page content; listed as a lead-ads prerequisite.
- `pages_manage_ads`: listed by the Lead Ads guide as required in App Review alongside `leads_retrieval`.
- `business_management`: Business Manager API (owned_ad_accounts etc.).
- All above need App Review for Advanced Access.

Insights vs leads:
- Insights + objects: `ads_read` (user or system-user token). https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/overview/authorization/
- Leads: `leads_retrieval` + `pages_manage_ads` (+ `pages_show_list`, `pages_read_engagement`, `ads_management` per the guides), with a **Page access token** from a user who can perform ADVERTISE on the Page; user tokens are rate-limited by active app users. Apps in Development mode cannot retrieve leads except those submitted by app-role users. https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/guides/lead-ads/ and .../lead-ads/retrieving/

Access tiers (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/overview/authorization/, changelog 05/04/2026):
- Platform-level Standard vs Advanced: Business-type apps get Standard automatically; Standard `ads_read`/`ads_management` is sufficient "if your app manages only your own ad account" (accounts where the app's business/roles have access). Managing other people's accounts needs Advanced Access via App Review.
- Marketing API Access Tier (renamed 2026): "Standard Access" -> **Limited Access** (default, "heavily rate-limited per ad account, for development only", 1 system user + 1 admin system user); "Advanced Access" -> **Full Access** ("lightly rate limited", 10 system users). Auto-upgrade threshold: >=500 successful Marketing API calls in 15 days, error rate <15% over last 500 calls. Rate-limit header value still reads `development_access` / `standard_access`.

Tokens (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/facebook-login/guides/access-tokens, .../get-long-lived, https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/system-users/install-apps-and-generate-tokens/):
- User token: short-lived ~1-2 h; exchange server-side: `GET /v{N}/oauth/access_token?grant_type=fb_exchange_token&client_id=&client_secret=&fb_exchange_token=` -> `{access_token, token_type:"bearer", expires_in}` (~60 days). Expired tokens cannot be exchanged.
- Page token: obtained from a user token (`GET /me/accounts`, unconfirmed on this pass but standard); long-lived Page tokens have no time-based expiry.
- System user token: `POST /{system-user-id}/access_tokens` with `business_app`, `scope`, `appsecret_proof`, `access_token`, `set_token_expires_in_60_days` (true = 60-day token, refresh via the fb_exchange_token flow; false/omitted = non-expiring, some businesses forced to expiring). App must have Marketing API standard access or higher; system user and app in same Business.
- `GET /debug_token?input_token=...` with an app token (`app_id|app_secret`) or developer user token -> `data: {app_id, application, data_access_expires_at, expires_at, is_valid, issued_at, scopes[], granular_scopes[{scope,target_ids[]}], user_id, profile_id, metadata, error{code,message,subcode}}`. `type` field: unconfirmed (not on the reference page). https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/reference/debug_token/

## 3. Listing ad accounts

- `id` = `act_{account_id}`; `account_id` is the bare numeric string. Fields: `name, currency (ISO 4217), timezone_name, timezone_offset_hours_utc, account_status, business{id,name}, disable_reason, amount_spent, spend_cap, min_daily_budget`. `account_status`: 1 ACTIVE, 2 DISABLED, 3 UNSETTLED, 7 PENDING_RISK_REVIEW, 8 PENDING_SETTLEMENT, 9 IN_GRACE_PERIOD, 100 PENDING_CLOSURE, 101 CLOSED, 201 ANY_ACTIVE, 202 ANY_CLOSED. Error 200 = permission. https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/reference/ad-account/
- `GET /me/adaccounts?fields=id,account_id,name,currency,timezone_name,account_status,business`: the user/adaccounts reference page returned 404 on this pass, so exact edge doc is **unconfirmed**; the edge is widely used and the fields are confirmed on the AdAccount node.
- `GET /{business-id}/owned_ad_accounts` (param `access_token`; adds `permitted_tasks`, `access_type` OWNER|AGENCY), `GET /{business-id}/pending_owned_ad_accounts`, `GET /{business-scoped-user-id}/assigned_ad_accounts`. `client_ad_accounts` edge: unconfirmed (404). https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/business-asset-management/guides/ad-accounts/

## 4. Insights

Reference: https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/reference/ad-account/insights/
- `GET /act_{id}/insights`. Params:
  - `level`: `account|campaign|adset|ad`.
  - `time_range`: `{"since":"YYYY-MM-DD","until":"YYYY-MM-DD"}` (since = midnight that day, until = midnight of the following day; UNIX timestamps not supported). `time_ranges` (list) overrides it.
  - `time_increment`: `monthly` | `all_days` (default) | integer 1..90. `1` = daily rows.
  - `date_preset` default `last_30d`; values incl. `today, yesterday, this_month, last_month, maximum, data_maximum, last_3d, last_7d, last_14d, last_28d, last_30d, last_90d, ...`. Ignored when `time_range` is set.
  - `action_attribution_windows`: list of `1d_view, 7d_view, 28d_view, 1d_click, 7d_click, 28d_click, 1d_ev, dda, default, ...`. Default `default`; the page states the default meaning inconsistently (`["7d_click","1d_view"]` in Reading, `["7d_view","1d_click"]` in Creating). Since Jan 12, 2026 `7d_view` and `28d_view` are no longer returned (https://developers.facebook.com/blog/post/2025/10/16/ads-insights-api-metric-availability-updates/).
  - `use_account_attribution_setting` (bool, default false): use the ad account's attribution setting. `use_unified_attribution_setting` (bool): use ad-set-level settings and match Ads Manager; overrides the account one. Best-practices page says since June 10, 2025 `use_unified_attribution_setting` and `action_report_time` are ignored and responses mirror Ads Manager; the reference still lists them, so set `use_unified_attribution_setting=true` and expect it to be a no-op.
  - `filtering`: `[{"field":"...","operator":"EQUAL|NOT_EQUAL|GREATER_THAN|GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL|LESS_THAN|LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL|IN_RANGE|NOT_IN_RANGE|CONTAIN|NOT_CONTAIN|IN|NOT_IN|STARTS_WITH|ENDS_WITH|ANY|ALL|AFTER|BEFORE|ON_OR_AFTER|ON_OR_BEFORE|NONE|TOP|...","value":"..."}]` (all three required; value is a string).
  - `breakdowns`, `action_breakdowns` (default `["action_type"]`; requires `actions` in fields), `limit`, `sort` (one element, e.g. `spend_descending`, `actions:lead_descending`), `default_summary`, `summary`.
  - `fields` default `impressions,spend`. Requested: `campaign_id,campaign_name,adset_id,adset_name,ad_id,ad_name,spend,impressions,clicks,reach,frequency,actions,action_values,cost_per_action_type,date_start,date_stop` (all confirmed as AdsInsights fields; name fields come back when level is at or below that object).
- Values: all numbers are **strings** (`"impressions": "361324"`, `"spend": "5339.5"`). `spend` is a decimal string in the account currency, major units (overview example; currency itself is not in the row, take it from the ad account). https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/insights/
- `actions`, `action_values`, `cost_per_action_type`: list of AdsActionStats `{action_type: string, value: numeric string, [1d_click, 7d_click, 28d_click, 1d_view, 1d_ev, ...]: numeric string}`; window keys appear only when `action_attribution_windows` asks for them. Lead action types: `lead` (all offsite + on-Facebook leads), `onsite_conversion.lead_grouped` (all on-Facebook leads), `leadgen_grouped` (Messenger + Instant Forms), `offsite_conversion.fb_pixel_lead` (pixel leads). https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/reference/ads-action-stats/
- Async: `POST /act_{id}/insights` (same params) -> `{"report_run_id": "<numeric string>"}`. Poll `GET /{report_run_id}` for `async_status` (`Job Not Started | Job Started | Job Running | Job Completed | Job Failed | Job Skipped`) and `async_percent_completion` (done when Completed and 100; Skipped = expired, resubmit). Then `GET /{report_run_id}/insights` (paged). `report_run_id` expires after 30 days; do not store. v25.0+: failed runs carry `error_code, error_message, error_subcode, error_user_title, error_user_msg`. When required: "Try sync calls first and then use async calls in cases where sync calls timeout"; sync calls have no fixed row cap but fail with error 100 / subcode **1487534** ("too much data") or time out; fix by narrowing dates, splitting metrics, querying lower levels, using `filtering`, `date_preset`, batching. Query unique metrics (reach, frequency) separately from non-unique ones. Reach/frequency are omitted from standard breakdown queries older than 13 months. https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/insights/best-practices/
- Date range: `since` cannot be more than **37 months** back (error 3018); `date_preset=maximum` = 37 months.

## 5. Paging

- Response: `{"data":[...],"paging":{"cursors":{"before":"...","after":"..."},"next":"<url>","previous":"<url>"}}`. Pass `after=<cursor>` (or just follow `paging.next`). No `next` = last page; a page may be empty yet still have `next`, so loop until `next` is absent. `limit` = max objects that may be returned; some edges cap it (no global max documented). Do not persist cursors. Offset paging exists but is discouraged; large cursors give error 100 "After Cursor ... exceeds the max limit". https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/results/
- Object edges (`/campaigns`, `/adsets`, `/ads`) also return `summary.total_count` when `summary=total_count` is requested.

## 6. Campaign / ad set / ad objects

- `GET /act_{id}/campaigns?fields=id,name,status,effective_status,objective,daily_budget,lifetime_budget,budget_remaining,start_time,stop_time,created_time,updated_time,bid_strategy,buying_type,special_ad_categories`. Edge params: `effective_status` (list; without it archived/deleted are excluded), `is_completed`, `date_preset`/`time_range` (for `insights` summary), `updated_since`. `status`: ACTIVE|PAUSED|DELETED|ARCHIVED. `effective_status`: ACTIVE|PAUSED|DELETED|ARCHIVED|IN_PROCESS|WITH_ISSUES. `objective` ODAX: OUTCOME_LEADS, OUTCOME_SALES, OUTCOME_TRAFFIC, OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT, OUTCOME_AWARENESS, OUTCOME_APP_PROMOTION (legacy values still appear). Campaign `start_time`/`stop_time` are read-only merges of ad set times; `updated_time` does not change on budget edits. https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/reference/ad-campaign-group/ and .../ad-account/campaigns/
- `GET /act_{id}/adsets?fields=id,name,campaign_id,status,effective_status,daily_budget,lifetime_budget,optimization_goal,billing_event,bid_amount,promoted_object,start_time,end_time,destination_type,created_time,updated_time`. `effective_status` adds CAMPAIGN_PAUSED. `optimization_goal` incl. LEAD_GENERATION, QUALITY_LEAD, OFFSITE_CONVERSIONS, LINK_CLICKS, REACH, IMPRESSIONS, LANDING_PAGE_VIEWS, CONVERSATIONS, VALUE... `promoted_object` keys by goal: `pixel_id`+`custom_event_type` (conversions), `page_id` (lead generation, page likes), `application_id`+`object_store_url` (apps), `product_set_id`, `event_id`, `offline_conversion_data_set_id`. `end_time=0` means no end on daily-budget sets. https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/reference/ad-campaign/
- `GET /act_{id}/ads?fields=id,name,adset_id,campaign_id,status,effective_status,creative{id},created_time,updated_time,preview_shareable_link`. `effective_status`: ACTIVE|PAUSED|DELETED|PENDING_REVIEW|DISAPPROVED|PREAPPROVED|PENDING_BILLING_INFO|CAMPAIGN_PAUSED|ARCHIVED|ADSET_PAUSED|IN_PROCESS|WITH_ISSUES. Edge params `effective_status`, `updated_since`, `date_preset`, `time_range`. Nested `creative{id,name}` field expansion is standard Graph syntax (not restated on the Ad page). https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/reference/adgroup/
- **Budget units confirmed**: budgets and bids are "set at the ad account currency's minimum denomination level, such as cents for USD": `daily_budget=2000` = $20, `lifetime_budget=20000` = $200 (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/bidding/overview/budgets/). Returned as numeric **strings**. Currency offset: AED 100, USD 100, JPY 1, KRW 1 (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/currencies/). `spend_cap` is likewise minor units on read. Insights `spend` is the exception (decimal major units).

## 7. Lead ads

Guide: https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/guides/lead-ads/retrieving/ ; forms: .../lead-ads/create/
- `GET /{page-id}/leadgen_forms?fields=id,name,status,questions&access_token=<PAGE_TOKEN>` (documented in the create guide; the edge reference page says "You can't perform this operation" for reading, which contradicts the guide: treat exact readable form fields such as `leads_count`, `locale`, `created_time` as unconfirmed). `GET /{form-id}?fields=questions` returns `questions[{type,key,label,options[{value,key}]}]`.
- `GET /{form-id}/leads` and `GET /{ad-id}/leads` (both return a list of UserLeadGenInfo nodes, paged). Documented fields: `id, created_time, ad_id, form_id, field_data, custom_disclaimer_responses[{checkbox_key,is_checked}]`. `field_data`: `[{"name": "<question key>", "values": ["..."]}]`. `adset_id, campaign_id, ad_name, adset_name, campaign_name, platform, is_organic` on the lead node: **unconfirmed** on this pass (the Lead node reference page 404'd); `is_organic` is confirmed only in the TSV export (`1` organic, else `0`). Reading `ad_id`/`campaign_id` requires advertiser privileges on the ad account; organic or ad-preview leads have no ad IDs.
- `GET /{lead-id}` for one lead (from webhook `leadgen_id`).
- Filtering: `filtering=[{"field":"time_created","operator":"GREATER_THAN","value":"<unix ts>"}]` (operators LESS_THAN, GREATER_THAN, GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL) on `/{ad-id}/leads`; the `/{adgroup-id}/leads` reference says the endpoint has no parameters, so verify on `/leads` edges in practice.
- Rate limit: per Page per 24 h = `200 * 24 * leads created in past 90 days`; BUC type `leadgen` in the usage header.
- Retention: official developer docs do not state a retention window. Third-party guides quote Meta Business Help Center: leads downloadable "for up to 90 days after they're submitted", then deleted. Treat **90 days as unconfirmed on developer docs**; design to pull leads promptly and store them.
- Webhooks: subscribe Page object field `leadgen`; `POST /{page-id}/subscribed_apps?subscribed_fields=leadgen` with Page token (needs `pages_manage_metadata`). Payload: `{"object":"page","entry":[{"id","time","changes":[{"field":"leadgen","value":{"leadgen_id","page_id","form_id","adgroup_id","ad_id","created_time"}}]}]}`; then fetch `/{leadgen_id}`. Delivery can lag a few minutes. https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/webhooks/getting-started/webhooks-for-leadgen

## 8. Errors and rate limits

- Shape: `{"error":{"message","type","code","error_subcode","error_user_title","error_user_msg","fbtrace_id","is_transient","error_data":{"blame_field_specs":[[...]]}}}` (last two Marketing-API specific). https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/guides/error-handling/ , https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/error-reference/
- Codes: 1 unknown (retry), 2 service (retry), 4 app-level throttle, 17 user-level throttle, 10 permission denied, 100 invalid parameter (subcode 1487534 = too much data; also cursor overflow), 102 session (re-auth), 190 invalid/expired token (subcodes 458 not installed, 460 password changed, 463 expired, 467 invalid), 200-299 permission (294 "Managing advertisements requires ... ads_management"), 341 app limit, 368 policy block, 613 custom rate limit, 80000 Ads Insights BUC limit, 80004 Ads Management BUC limit (also returned on `/leads`), 80001 Pages BUC. Error 4 subcode 1504022 = global insights throttle. Code 2635 (deprecated version): unconfirmed.
- Headers: `x-business-use-case-usage`: `{"<business/account id>":[{"type":"ads_insights|ads_management|custom_audience|leadgen|pages|...","call_count":%,"total_cputime":%,"total_time":%,"estimated_time_to_regain_access":<minutes>,"ads_api_access_tier":"development_access|standard_access"}]}`. `x-ad-account-usage`: `{"acc_id_util_pct":%,"reset_time_duration":<seconds>,"ads_api_access_tier"}`. `x-fb-ads-insights-throttle`: `{"app_id_util_pct","acc_id_util_pct","ads_api_access_tier"}`. Limits per rolling hour per account: insights Standard `600 + 400*active_ads`, Advanced `190000 + 400*active_ads`; management `300 + 40*active_ads` / `100000 + 40*active_ads`. https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/overview/rate-limiting/
- Backoff: Meta gives no algorithm. Documented guidance: stop calling once throttled (continuing extends the penalty), sleep `estimated_time_to_regain_access` minutes (or `reset_time_duration` seconds), back off as `call_count`/util pct approaches 100, spread requests evenly, rotate to other ad accounts. Practical: exponential backoff with jitter for 1/2/4/17/613/80000/80004, no retry on 100/190/200-299.

## 9. Data freshness

- Insights refresh every 15 minutes; reported in the ad account's timezone (convert to Dubai day in ADX). Metrics can keep updating for a couple of days after an ad stops; "data stops changing 28 days after it is reported" (attribution windows up to 28d_click). Re-pull at least the trailing 28 days. https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/insights/best-practices/
- Lookback: totals available 37 months; since Jan 12, 2026 unique-count fields and hourly breakdowns limited to 13 months, `frequency_value` breakdown to 6 months; reach/frequency omitted for breakdown queries starting >13 months back. https://developers.facebook.com/blog/post/2025/10/16/ads-insights-api-metric-availability-updates/

## 10. Later phases (endpoints only)

- Conversions API: `POST /v{N}/{pixel-id}/events` with `data:[{event_name,event_time (unix s, <=7 days old),action_source,event_id,event_source_url,user_data{em[],ph[] SHA-256},custom_data}]`, optional `test_event_code`; max 1000 events/request, whole batch rejected on any invalid event. https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/conversions-api/using-the-api/
- Custom Audiences: `POST /act_{id}/customaudiences` (`name, subtype=CUSTOM, customer_file_source, description`); `POST /{audience-id}/users` with `payload:{schema:"EMAIL"|[multi-key],data:[[...]]}` + `session:{session_id,batch_seq,last_batch_flag,estimated_num_total}`, SHA-256 lowercase hex, <=10,000 users/request; `DELETE /{audience-id}/users`; `POST /{audience-id}/usersreplace`. https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/audiences/guides/custom-audiences/

## Unconfirmed list
`GET /me/adaccounts` reference page (404), `client_ad_accounts` edge, lead node fields `adset_id/campaign_id/platform/is_organic` via API, 90-day lead retention on developer docs, `debug_token` `type` field, error code 2635, readable LeadgenForm fields beyond `id,name,status,questions`, `GET /{report_run_id}` field names beyond `async_status`/`async_percent_completion` (AdReportRun reference 404'd).
